mapper.select: select count(*) as totalOrders, coalesce(sum(total), 0) as totalSales, coalesce(round(avg(total), 2), 0) as avgOrder, coalesce(sum(case when status = '已完成' then total else 0 end), 0) as completedSales, count(case when status = '已完成' then 1 end) as completedOrders from `order`

select date_format(time, '%Y-%m-%d') as dateKey, count(*) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(total), 0) as sales from `order` where time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and status not in ('已取消', '待付款') group by date_format(time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by dateKey

select date_format(time, '%Y-%m') as dateKey, count(*) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(total), 0) as sales from `order` where time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{months} * 30 day) and status not in ('已取消', '待付款') group by date_format(time, '%Y-%m') order by dateKey

select coalesce(c.name, '未分类') as name, coalesce(sum(oi.goods_price * oi.num), 0) as sales, count(distinct oi.order_id) as orderCount from order_item oi left join goods g on oi.goods_id = g.id left join category c on g.category_id = c.id left join `order` o on oi.order_id = o.id where o.status not in ('已取消', '待付款') group by c.id, c.name order by sales desc

select g.id as goodsId, g.name as goodsName, g.img as goodsImg, coalesce(g.sale_count, 0) as saleCount, coalesce(sum(oi.goods_price * oi.num), 0) as totalSales from goods g left join order_item oi on g.id = oi.goods_id left join `order` o on oi.order_id = o.id and o.status not in ('已取消', '待付款') group by g.id, g.name, g.img, g.sale_count order by saleCount desc limit #{limit}
